scope: Read-only metadata and aggregate assessment. No rows imported, no DDL/DML, no application connectivity or load test.

tables.name: public.company_standard
tables.comment: 公司标准名称；子公司、分公司保留独立实体。A/B/C为已知关系图中的初始编号层级，不证明独立法人或最终集团归属。

columns.name: relationship_check_status
columns.comment: 名称核验与关系查询分开；未找到关系不能推断没有母公司。

columns.name: review_status
columns.check: review_status = ANY (ARRAY['无需人工审核'::text, '待审核'::text, '已通过'::text, '已否决'::text])
columns.comment: 无需人工审核；为兼容保留，不参与入库或关系导出条件。

columns.name: child_company_codes
columns.comment: 有效已核验直接子/分公司编号数组，关系变更时同步快照。NULL未知，空数组明确确认无关系；按日期实时读取用company_standard_display，重新物化用company_refresh_relation_codes()。

columns.name: parent_company_codes
columns.comment: 有效已核验直接母/总公司编号数组，关系变更时同步快照。NULL未知，空数组明确确认无关系；按日期实时读取用company_standard_display，重新物化用company_refresh_relation_codes()。

columns.name: name_confidence
columns.comment: 仅名称匹配置信度0到1；历史未评估保持NULL，不代表关系置信度。

tables.name: public.school_standard

tables.name: public.major_standard
tables.comment: 专业及学科名称词条；目录匹配不能反推来源个人学历、就读院校或年代。

columns.name: catalog_matches

columns.name: review_status

view_definitions.name: name_normalization_groups
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT entity_type,
    standard_code,
    standard_name,
    count(DISTINCT source_id) AS source_count,
    count(DISTINCT raw_name) AS raw_variant_count,
    array_agg(DISTINCT raw_name ORDER BY raw_name) AS raw_name_variants
   FROM name_mapping_export
  WHERE (processing_status = '已匹配'::text)
  GROUP BY entity_type, standard_code, standard_name;

view_definitions.name: entity_name_comparison
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT ('R'::text || lpad((row_number() OVER (ORDER BY
        CASE m.entity_type
            WHEN 'company'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'school'::text THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END, m.source_file, m.source_row, m.item_no, m.id))::text, 6, '0'::text)) AS comparison_no,
        CASE m.entity_type
            WHEN 'company'::text THEN '公司'::text
            WHEN 'school'::text THEN '学校'::text
            ELSE '专业'::text
        END AS entity_type,
    m.raw_name AS original_content,
    m.cleaned_name,
    COALESCE(c.standard_name, s.standard_name, p.standard_name, (m.attributes ->> 'candidate_standard_name'::text)) AS standard_name,
    COALESCE(c.company_code, s.school_code, p.major_code) AS standard_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.entity_type <> 'company'::text) THEN '不适用'::text
            WHEN (c.id IS NULL) THEN '公司主体待确认，未关联上下级'::text
            ELSE COALESCE(rel.relationships, c.relationship_check_status, '尚未确认上下级关系'::text)
        END AS company_relationships,
    m.processing_status,
    ne.notes AS name_evidence,
    ne.urls AS name_evidence_urls,
    rel.notes AS relationship_evidence,
    rel.urls AS relationship_evidence_urls,
    m.match_reason,
    m.source_id,
    m.source_file,
    m.source_row,
    m.item_no,
    m.review_status,
    m.id AS mapping_id
   FROM (((((name_mapping m
     LEFT JOIN company_standard c ON ((c.id = m.company_id)))
     LEFT JOIN school_standard s ON ((s.id = m.school_id)))
     LEFT JOIN major_standard p ON ((p.id = m.major_id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT
                CASE
                    WHEN ((ev.value ->> 'title'::text) ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) THEN concat_ws('：'::text, '附件资料', regexp_replace(regexp_replace((ev.value ->> 'quote'::text), '<[^>]*>'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text), '[[:cntrl:]]'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text))
                    ELSE concat_ws('：'::text, NULLIF((ev.value ->> 'title'::text), ''::text), NULLIF((ev.value ->> 'quote'::text), ''::text))
                END, '
'::text) AS notes,
            string_agg(DISTINCT NULLIF((ev.value ->> 'url'::text), ''::text), '
'::text) AS urls
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(
                CASE
                    WHEN (jsonb_array_length(m.evidence) > 0) THEN m.evidence
                    ELSE COALESCE(c.evidence, s.evidence, p.evidence, '[]'::jsonb)
                END) ev(value)) ne ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT r.relationship_text, '
'::text) AS relationships,
            string_agg(DISTINCT r.evidence_note, '
'::text) AS notes,
            string_agg(DISTINCT r.source_url, '
'::text) AS urls
           FROM ( SELECT (((
                        CASE
                            WHEN (cr.child_company_id = c.id) THEN (((
                            CASE
                                WHEN (cr.relation_type = '分公司'::text) THEN '总公司：'::text
                                ELSE '母公司：'::text
                            END || parent.company_code) || ' '::text) || parent.standard_name)
                            ELSE (((
                            CASE
                                WHEN (cr.relation_type = '分公司'::text) THEN '分公司：'::text
                                ELSE '子公司：'::text
                            END || child.company_code) || ' '::text) || child.standard_name)
                        END || '（'::text) || cr.verification_status) || '）'::text) AS relationship_text,
                    cr.evidence_note,
                    cr.source_url
                   FROM ((company_relation cr
                     JOIN company_standard parent ON ((parent.id = cr.parent_company_id)))
                     JOIN company_standard child ON ((child.id = cr.child_company_id)))
                  WHERE ((c.id IS NOT NULL) AND ((cr.parent_company_id = c.id) OR (cr.child_company_id = c.id)) AND (cr.verification_status = '已核验'::text))) r) rel ON (true));

view_definitions.name: company_standard_display
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT s.standard_name AS "公司名",
    s.company_code AS "编号",
        CASE
            WHEN (c.codes IS NULL) THEN NULL::jsonb
            WHEN (cardinality(c.codes) = 0) THEN '0'::jsonb
            ELSE to_jsonb(c.codes)
        END AS "子公司",
        CASE
            WHEN (p.codes IS NULL) THEN NULL::jsonb
            WHEN (cardinality(p.codes) = 0) THEN '0'::jsonb
            ELSE to_jsonb(p.codes)
        END AS "母公司",
    s.name_confidence AS "置信度",
    s.relationship_check_status AS "关系查询状态",
    s.relationship_check_note AS "关系查询说明",
    s.evidence AS "名称证据",
    ( SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('关系编号', r.id, '类型', r.relation_type, '母公司编号', parent.company_code, '子公司编号', child.company_code, '核验状态', r.verification_status, '关系置信度', r.confidence, '生效日', r.valid_from, '终止日', r.valid_to, '证据', r.evidence, '证据说明', r.evidence_note) ORDER BY r.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS "coalesce"
           FROM ((company_relation r
             JOIN company_standard parent ON ((parent.id = r.parent_company_id)))
             JOIN company_standard child ON ((child.id = r.child_company_id)))
          WHERE (((r.parent_company_id = s.id) OR (r.child_company_id = s.id)) AND (r.relation_type = ANY (ARRAY['子公司'::text, '分公司'::text])) AND (r.verification_status = '已核验'::text) AND (r.review_status <> '已否决'::text) AND ((r.valid_from IS NULL) OR (r.valid_from <= CURRENT_DATE)) AND ((r.valid_to IS NULL) OR (r.valid_to >= CURRENT_DATE)))) AS "关系证据",
    s.id AS "公司UUID"
   FROM ((company_standard s
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT company_current_relation_codes(s.id, s.relationship_check_status, 'child'::text) AS codes) c)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT company_current_relation_codes(s.id, s.relationship_check_status, 'parent'::text) AS codes) p);

view_definitions.name: company_relation_export
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.parent_company_id,
    r.child_company_id,
    r.relation_type,
    r.verification_status,
    r.valid_from,
    r.valid_to,
    r.source_url,
    r.evidence_note,
    r.evidence,
    r.review_status,
    r.reviewed_by,
    r.reviewed_at,
    r.remark,
    r.created_at,
    r.updated_at,
    p.company_code AS parent_company_code,
    p.standard_name AS parent_company_name,
    c.company_code AS child_company_code,
    c.standard_name AS child_company_name,
    (r.verification_status = '已核验'::text) AS ready_for_export
   FROM ((company_relation r
     JOIN company_standard p ON ((p.id = r.parent_company_id)))
     JOIN company_standard c ON ((c.id = r.child_company_id)));

view_definitions.name: name_mapping_export
view_definitions.definition:
SELECT m.id,
    m.batch_no,
    m.source_id,
    m.source_file,
    m.source_sheet,
    m.source_row,
    m.original_database_id,
    m.entity_type,
    m.item_id,
    m.item_no,
    m.raw_name,
    m.cleaned_name,
    m.company_id,
    m.school_id,
    m.major_id,
    m.processing_status,
    m.match_reason,
    m.source_url,
    m.evidence_note,
    m.evidence,
    m.attributes,
    m.review_status,
    m.reviewed_by,
    m.reviewed_at,
    m.remark,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at,
    COALESCE(c.company_code, s.school_code, p.major_code) AS standard_code,
    COALESCE(c.standard_name, s.standard_name, p.standard_name, (m.attributes ->> 'candidate_standard_name'::text)) AS standard_name,
    COALESCE(c.review_status, s.review_status, p.review_status) AS standard_review_status,
    (m.processing_status = '已匹配'::text) AS ready_for_export
   FROM (((name_mapping m
     LEFT JOIN company_standard c ON ((c.id = m.company_id)))
     LEFT JOIN school_standard s ON ((s.id = m.school_id)))
     LEFT JOIN major_standard p ON ((p.id = m.major_id)));
